Isaya 41:13

"Usiogope, nitakusaidia."

Maneno haya BWANA mwenyewe anayatamka kwako — si ahadi ya mbali, bali ya karibu mno. Kama hofu inakufinya leo, jua kwamba Yeye aliyekuumba yu pembeni yako, tayari kushika mkono wako na kukusaidia.

#Isaya #Usiogope #MunguMsaidizi #Imani #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

Lamentations 3:22

"The faithful love of the LORD never ends! His mercies never cease."

Every new morning is quiet proof that God's mercy has not run out on you. Whatever yesterday held, His compassion meets you fresh today — great is His faithfulness.

#Lamentations #MercyOfGod #FaithfulLove #NewMercies #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

Yohana 14:1

"Msifadhaike mioyoni mwenu; mnamwamini Mungu, niaminini na mimi."

Akifahamu kabisa jinsi mioyo yetu inavyoweza kufadhaika kirahisi, Yesu hututangulizia amani yake ya ndani hata kabla ya majaribu. Mkabidhi Bwana Yesu imani yako kamili leo, na moyo wako utafurahia amani isiyoelezeka inayopita ufahamu wote.

#Yohana #Msifadhaike #Imani #AmaniYaKristo #BibliaTafsiriMbalimbali

Isaiah 41:13

"Fear not, for I am the one who helps you."

The God who formed you does not shout this from a distance — He holds your right hand as He says it. Whatever fear you carry today, put it down; your Helper is already beside you.

Mathayo 6:33

"Bali utafuteni kwanza ufalme wake, na haki yake; na hayo yote mtazidishiwa."

Mungu huyafahamu mahitaji yako yote, huku akiweka kipaumbele chake kwanza, mengine yatafuata kwa mpangilio.
Ukiutafuta ufalme wake leo, utashuhudia mambo mengine ya maisha yakikaa mahali pake pasipo hofu.

"Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid."

Jesus does not hand out peace like the world does — conditional, temporary, easily lost. His peace guards the heart that stays close to Him, so keep your grip on His words today.
